lanes.summary: The provided diff implements `extract:json` correctly and aligns perfectly with all PMAT-3515 requirements. The `json.rs` extractor correctly applies vocabulary mapping, processes scalars/nested objects/arrays, skips nulls, and emits RDF triples with proper datatypes. Errors (`ExtractError`) and non-fatal warnings (torn `.jsonl` lines) are modeled as specified and propagated to the CLI layer. `extract::all` ensures single-walk parity for extraction and linting. All 8 required unit tests and 7 integration tests are provided. `contracts/ontology.yaml` and `contracts.nt` are appropriately updated. No gates are weakened and no unwarranted logic is introduced.

findings.claim: Contract ont-extract-json-v1 defines invariants EXJ-INV-001..005 and falsification tests FALSIFY-EXJ-001..005 for JSON/JSONL RDF extraction.
Implements extract:json with deterministic RDF generation, JSON type-to-XSD literal mappings, unmapped nested key refusal (ExtractError::Unmapped), and non-fatal torn JSONL line warning tracking.
Implements extract::all providing the unified single walk shared between pv lint --gate shapes and pv extract.
Integrates ShapesOutcome::ExtractFailed into shapes gate and records extraction warnings as ValidationResult with Severity::Warning (evaluating to Unknown{Warn}).

Provides 7 end-to-end integration tests in CLI suite verifying conforming entities, closed shape violations, exit 3 refusals on missing ref and unmapped keys, torn JSONL warnings, and extraction determinism.
